exceptions.rationale: The crate is absent from normal and build dependencies for the wasm32-unknown-unknown production target. It is limited to native Soroban host tooling and fixture test signing while contract P-256 verification is delegated to the host. Upgrade when the supported Soroban SDK moves to the fixed crypto-bigint line; do not introduce native production cryptography through this exception.
